question:
Identify the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

His __jovial__ nature has won him many friends.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"jovial"** means cheerful and friendly. (मिलनसार और हंसमुख)

 
 
• **Example: **His **jovial **laugh could brighten anyone's day.
 
 
 
• **"Miserable" **refers to someone who is very unhappy or uncomfortable. (दुखी और असहज)
 
 
• **Example: **She felt **miserable** after hearing the bad news.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'jovial' **is **'miserable'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Cunning **(चालाक): Having or showing skill in achieving one's ends by deceit or evasion.

 
 
• **Example:** The** cunning** fox easily outwitted the hunters.
 
 
 
• **Shrewd **(चतुर): Having or showing sharp powers of judgment; astute.
 
 
• **Example: **He is a **shrewd** businessman who always gets the best deals.
 
 
 
• **Dumb** (मूर्ख): Lacking intelligence or common sense.
 
 
• **Example:** It was a **dumb** mistake to leave the keys inside the car.
 
 

39:Tc61,

The correct answer is **Option 1)**
